name: Ride split by miles
summary: One rideshare receipt, several drop-offs: the route drawn as a road with a colored strand per rider that peels off at their stop, the fare split by the miles each person rode, an even split to compare, then requests and pay-backs to whoever paid.
useWhen: splitting an uber or lyft with several drop-offs: 'the 2am ride back, $54, calvin got out first'
'i only rode 2 miles why am i paying the same'
someone shared a ride receipt and asked everyone to pay them back
dontUseWhen: a road trip where one friend drove and bought gas (use gas-pump)
deciding who rides in which car (use carpool)
an ordinary bill with no distances (use a bill split)

ride.description: What the ride was, e.g. '2am ride back from the city'

payer.description: Who paid and shared the receipt

tenths.description: miles from the start in tenths, increasing

said.description: What someone already said about the split
